To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have derived an approximate capacity expression for the 3-user WRDP channel.
we have derived upper and lower bounds on the capacity of the M-receiver random WRDP channel, which are within a distance of O(log M) bpcu of the true capacity for all channel parameters.
we derive upper and a lower bounds to the approximate capacity of 3-receiver dirty paper channel.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of efficient coding schemes for the M-receiver “writing-on-dirty-paper” channel.
the problem of transmitting information over a multiple-access channel with a common state.
the problem of communication over a multiple access channel (MAC) with state, in the presence of a receiver with side information.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the capacity of the WRDP channel with M possible state sequences is to within a distance 3bpcu of the capacity obtained using the following strategy: the channel input is the superposition of M codewords and time-sharing is employed to guarantee decoding regardless of the state sequence.

we have derived upper and lower bounds on the capacity of the general WRDP channel which differ by at most 3 bpcu for all channel parameters and which are to within 3 bpcus of the capacity of the special 3-receiver case for all channel parameters.
the 3-receivers WRDP capacity lies between 1.5 bpcu and 3.5 bpc.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, for the first time, the capacity region of the 3-user WRDP channel has been determined to within a distance at most 3 bpcu for all channel parameters.
we have provided a complete analysis of the capacity of the WRDP channel with three possible state realisations.
the capacity of the general M-receiver WRPD channel is to within a distance 3bpcu from the capacity of a channel in which the transmitter has perfect channel state information.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the capacity of WRDP channel with M possible state realizations can be achieved to within a distance at most 1 + 1/2 + … + 1/M bits-per-channel-use.
the WRDP channel can be approached to within a constant number of bpcu for any number of receivers.
the capacity region of the WRDP is not necessarily convex.
